plan.name: Project 1 - Test Case Design
plan.notes: SECJ3343 Project 1 manual case design; no execution results claimed.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-001 - Prefill all saved fields

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Inspect the five form controls without changing or submitting them.
steps.expected_results: Task Title "Prepare sprint review"; Description "Agenda draft"; Priority "Low"; Status "In Progress"; Due Date value "2028-02-29". No saved value has been replaced by a creation default.
Dialog closes; no edit is committed.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-002 - Prefill empty optional fields

steps.actions: For this case only, before opening edit, set B.description to "" in stored JSON and reload; recapture bBefore.
steps.expected_results: Fixture B is available with description "" and dueDate "".
"Edit Task" has title "Book meeting room", empty Description and Due Date, "Medium", "To Do".
Dialog closes without saving.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-003 - Save title-only edit with identity retained

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Replace Task Title with "Prepare final sprint review"; leave other controls unchanged.
steps.expected_results: Draft title is "Prepare final sprint review".

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. A.title is "Prepare final sprint review"; description, priority, status and dueDate equal bBefore A.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-004 - Save description-only edit

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".
Draft retains the two entered lines.

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. A.description is exactly "Final agenda Bring demo"; A title/priority/status/dueDate stay unchanged.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-005 - Save all editable fields together

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Enter title "Review launch plan", description "Review checklist"; select High, Completed; set Due Date to 2028-03-15.
steps.expected_results: Draft contains those five values (status/date selection is setup, not a validation or status/count assertion).

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. A stores "Review launch plan", "Review checklist", "High", "Completed", "2028-03-15".
"Edit Task" contains all five saved values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-006 - Clear existing optional description and date

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Clear Description and Due Date; leave the other values unchanged.
steps.expected_results: Both optional controls are empty.

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. A.description and A.dueDate are both ""; other editable values remain unchanged.
Description and Due Date are empty in "Edit Task".

records.tcase_name: TC-B-007 - Save unchanged form still updates metadata

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. All five editable values equal bBefore A; only updatedAt changes.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-008 - Edit one same-title sibling only

steps.actions: Before opening edit, set B.title to "Prepare sprint review" in stored JSON; reload; recapture bBefore.
steps.expected_results: A and B share the title but retain ids b-alpha and b-beta and distinct descriptions.

steps.actions: Within the card whose description is "Room 4", click Edit; replace Description with "Room 7".
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens with B's values and accepts the draft description.
"Task updated successfully."; only b-beta.description becomes "Room 7" and its updatedAt advances. Its id/createdAt stay unchanged; A and C equal bBefore. There are still three objects.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-009 - Repeat edits to the same task

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Set Description to "Revision one"; save; inspect A JSON and record first updatedAt.
steps.expected_results: "Task updated successfully."; A.description "Revision one"; original id/createdAt preserved.

steps.actions: Wait at least 1 second; reopen A edit, set Description to "Revision two"; save.
steps.expected_results: Form initially shows "Revision one"; closes with "Task updated successfully." after save.
Only A contains "Revision two"; updatedAt is later than the first save. No extra object; B/C unchanged.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-010 - Edit different tasks in sequence

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Set Description to "A revised"; click "Save Changes"; then click "Edit Book meeting room".
steps.expected_results: Edit success toast; new "Edit Task" shows B: "Book meeting room", "Room 4", "Medium", "To Do", empty date.

steps.actions: Set Description to "B revised"; save; inspect JSON.
steps.expected_results: "Task updated successfully."; A has "A revised", B has "B revised". Their original ids/createdAt remain; C unchanged.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-011 - Reject blank-title edit atomically

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Replace Task Title with three spaces. Also select High as a proposed valid edit.
steps.expected_results: Draft is entered; stored A still has Low.

steps.actions: Click "Save Changes"; inspect stored JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" stays open. "Title is required." is displayed. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears. Priority remains Low in saved A; the valid field change is not partially saved.
Dialog closes; original A remains.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-012 - Reject short-title edit atomically

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Replace Task Title with "ab". Also select High as a proposed valid edit.
steps.expected_results: Draft is entered; stored A still has Low.

steps.actions: Click "Save Changes"; inspect stored JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" stays open. "Title must be at least 3 characters." is displayed. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears. Priority remains Low in saved A; the valid field change is not partially saved.
Dialog closes; original A remains.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-013 - Reject overlong-title edit atomically

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Use DevTools copy("x".repeat(81)); close Console and paste into Task Title. Also select High as a proposed valid edit.
steps.expected_results: Draft is entered; stored A still has Low.

steps.actions: Click "Save Changes"; inspect stored JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" stays open. "Title must be 80 characters or fewer." is displayed. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears. Priority remains Low in saved A; the valid field change is not partially saved.
Dialog closes; original A remains.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-014 - Reject overlong-description edit atomically

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Use DevTools copy("d".repeat(501)); close Console and paste into Description. Also select High as a proposed valid edit.
steps.expected_results: Draft is entered; stored A still has Low.

steps.actions: Click "Save Changes"; inspect stored JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" stays open. "Description must be 500 characters or fewer." is displayed. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears. Priority remains Low in saved A; the valid field change is not partially saved.
Dialog closes; original A remains.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-015 - Reject two invalid fields without partial save

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Clear Task Title; paste exactly 501 copies of d into Description using copy("d".repeat(501)). Also select High as a proposed valid edit.
steps.expected_results: Draft is entered; stored A still has Low.

steps.actions: Click "Save Changes"; inspect stored JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" stays open. Both "Title is required." and "Description must be 500 characters or fewer." are displayed. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears. Priority remains Low in saved A; the valid field change is not partially saved.
Dialog closes; original A remains.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-016 - Correct rejected edit and save once

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Clear Task Title; set Description to "Revised agenda"; click "Save Changes".
steps.expected_results: "Title is required."; "Edit Task" stays open; Description draft remains "Revised agenda"; stored JSON equals bBefore.

steps.actions: Replace Task Title with "Prepare corrected review"; click "Save Changes"; inspect JSON.
steps.expected_results: Form closes; "Task updated successfully."; A stores corrected title and "Revised agenda"; same id/createdAt, later updatedAt. Three objects; B and C unchanged.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-017 - Save priority edit and retain it after reload

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Change Priority from Low to High; leave every other form value unchanged.
steps.expected_results: Priority control shows "High".

steps.actions: Record new Date().toISOString() in Console immediately before save; close Console, click "Save Changes", observe toast, record the time again and inspect saved JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes; "Task updated successfully." appears. Stored array has the same three ids; A retains id b-alpha and createdAt 2026-01-01T09:00:00.000Z; updatedAt is valid ISO, later than 2026-01-02T10:00:00.000Z and within the recorded save interval. B and C are field-for-field unchanged from bBefore. A.priority "High"; its other form values are unchanged; A card badge "High".

steps.actions: Reload; inspect A JSON; reopen A edit.
steps.expected_results: A.priority is still "High"; "Edit Task" Priority is "High"; id and createdAt remain the original values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-018 - Latest repeated priority edit wins

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Choose High; save; record A.updatedAt; wait at least 1 second; reopen A edit.
steps.expected_results: "Task updated successfully."; reopened Priority is "High".

steps.actions: Choose Medium; save; reload; inspect A JSON and reopen edit.
steps.expected_results: "Task updated successfully." at save; latest saved/control/card priority is "Medium". Same id/createdAt; updatedAt later than the first save. B/C unchanged.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-019 - Discard dirty edit using Cancel button

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Change title to "Discarded draft", Description to "Unsaved agenda" and Priority to High.
steps.expected_results: Draft values are visible in "Edit Task".
"Edit Task" closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.
Title "Prepare sprint review", Description "Agenda draft", Priority "Low"; no discarded values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-020 - Discard dirty edit using Close X button

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Change title to "Discarded draft", Description to "Unsaved agenda" and Priority to High.
steps.expected_results: Draft values are visible in "Edit Task".

steps.actions: Click the dialog X button with accessible label "Close".
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.
Title "Prepare sprint review", Description "Agenda draft", Priority "Low"; no discarded values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-021 - Discard dirty edit using Escape key

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Change title to "Discarded draft", Description to "Unsaved agenda" and Priority to High.
steps.expected_results: Draft values are visible in "Edit Task".

steps.actions: Press Escape while Task Title is focused.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.
Title "Prepare sprint review", Description "Agenda draft", Priority "Low"; no discarded values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-022 - Discard dirty edit using dark backdrop

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Change title to "Discarded draft", Description to "Unsaved agenda" and Priority to High.
steps.expected_results: Draft values are visible in "Edit Task".

steps.actions: Press and release the mouse on the dark backdrop outside the white dialog.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.
Title "Prepare sprint review", Description "Agenda draft", Priority "Low"; no discarded values.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-023 - Cancel a rejected draft

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".
"Title is required."; dialog stays open; saved JSON unchanged.
"Edit Task" closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-024 - Cancel untouched edit without advancing timestamp

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Without touching any field, click "Cancel"; inspect raw JSON.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes. All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-025 - Reopen after rejected draft dismissal clears draft and errors

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Clear title; set Description to "Abandoned revision"; click "Save Changes".
steps.expected_results: "Title is required."; draft Description remains "Abandoned revision".
New "Edit Task" contains "Prepare sprint review" and "Agenda draft"; previous "Title is required." is absent.
All stored objects equal bBefore field-for-field, including id, createdAt and updatedAt. No "Task updated successfully." appears.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-026 - Clicking inside edit modal does not discard draft

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Set Description to "Interior draft"; click the "Edit Task" heading, then click the Description control.
steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" remains open with "Interior draft"; neither click saves or discards it.

steps.actions: Inspect stored JSON without reload; then click "Cancel".
steps.expected_results: Stored JSON equals bBefore; Cancel closes the draft.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-027 - Cancel priority-only change then reload

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Choose High; click "Cancel"; reload and inspect A JSON; reopen A edit.
steps.expected_results: A.priority stays "Low" in JSON and the form; no "Task updated successfully." from cancellation; all fields and timestamps equal bBefore A.
Dialog closes without saving.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-028 - Exact confirmation before any deletion

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Read the dialog heading, full text and buttons; inspect JSON without reloading.
steps.expected_results: Heading "Delete Task"; text exactly Are you sure you want to delete "Prepare sprint review"? This cannot be undone. Buttons "Cancel", "Confirm Delete"; all saved objects still equal bBefore.
Dialog closes without deleting.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-029 - Confirmation uses latest saved title and punctuation

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Set title to the exact text Review "Beta" & notes; save; click Delete on that newly titled card.
steps.expected_results: "Task updated successfully." at save; "Delete Task" opens for b-alpha.
Exactly: Are you sure you want to delete "Review "Beta" & notes"? This cannot be undone. Original title "Prepare sprint review" is not used in the confirmation; no deletion yet.
Edited task remains saved with its current title.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-030 - Confirm deletion leaves siblings intact

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Click "Confirm Delete"; observe toast, inspect stored objects, then reload.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" closes; "Task deleted successfully." appears. Only b-alpha is absent from taskflow_tasks; B and C are unchanged, including all timestamps. Reload still contains exactly B and C.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-031 - Confirm deletion of the sole remaining task

steps.actions: Before opening deletion, replace stored array with only fixture A; reload; recapture bBefore.
steps.expected_results: Exactly the valid fixture A is present (fixture setup only).
"Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Click "Confirm Delete"; observe toast; inspect taskflow_tasks and reload.
steps.expected_results: Dialog closes with "Task deleted successfully."; taskflow_tasks is [] and remains [] after reload; no task with id b-alpha exists. Empty-state copy/counts are outside this assertion.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-032 - Delete only intended same-title sibling

steps.actions: Before deletion set B.title to "Prepare sprint review" in stored JSON; reload; recapture bBefore.
steps.expected_results: A/B share a title and retain different ids/descriptions.

steps.actions: Within the card with Description "Room 4", click Delete.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" says exactly Are you sure you want to delete "Prepare sprint review"? This cannot be undone.
"Task deleted successfully."; only b-beta is removed; A and C exactly equal their bBefore objects. The remaining same-title card is A with "Agenda draft".

records.tcase_name: TC-B-033 - Dismiss deletion using Cancel button

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.
"Delete Task" closes. All three saved objects equal bBefore field-for-field including timestamps; A is still present. No "Task deleted successfully." appears.
All three original objects remain, including b-alpha and its unchanged timestamps.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-034 - Dismiss deletion using Close X button

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Click X with accessible label "Close". Inspect stored JSON.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" closes. All three saved objects equal bBefore field-for-field including timestamps; A is still present. No "Task deleted successfully." appears.
All three original objects remain, including b-alpha and its unchanged timestamps.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-035 - Dismiss deletion using Escape key

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Press Escape while the dialog is open. Inspect stored JSON.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" closes. All three saved objects equal bBefore field-for-field including timestamps; A is still present. No "Task deleted successfully." appears.
All three original objects remain, including b-alpha and its unchanged timestamps.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-036 - Dismiss deletion using dark backdrop

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Press and release on the dark backdrop outside the white dialog. Inspect stored JSON.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" closes. All three saved objects equal bBefore field-for-field including timestamps; A is still present. No "Task deleted successfully." appears.
All three original objects remain, including b-alpha and its unchanged timestamps.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-037 - Interior deletion click is not a confirmation or dismissal

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.
"Delete Task" stays open with exactly Are you sure you want to delete "Prepare sprint review"? This cannot be undone. No object is changed or removed.
All three saved objects equal bBefore field-for-field including timestamps; A is still present. No "Task deleted successfully." appears.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-038 - Reopen after canceled deletion targets newly selected task

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.
"Delete Task" now says exactly: Are you sure you want to delete "Book meeting room"? This cannot be undone. A is not used as the new confirmation target.
"Task deleted successfully."; only b-beta is removed. A and C equal bBefore.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-039 - Repeated cancellation then one confirmed deletion

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Click "Cancel"; reopen A Delete; press Escape; reopen A Delete.
steps.expected_results: Both dismissals retain all original objects; each reopened dialog contains exactly Are you sure you want to delete "Prepare sprint review"? This cannot be undone.

steps.actions: Click "Confirm Delete" once; inspect JSON and reload.
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" closes; "Task deleted successfully." appears. Only b-alpha is absent from taskflow_tasks; B and C are unchanged, including all timestamps. Reload still contains exactly B and C. There is no second pending deletion dialog.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-040 - Consecutive deletions never reuse old target

steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" opens; A is still present.

steps.actions: Confirm Delete A, then click "Delete Book meeting room".
steps.expected_results: First toast "Task deleted successfully."; second dialog warns exactly: Are you sure you want to delete "Book meeting room"? This cannot be undone.

steps.actions: Click "Confirm Delete" on B; observe toast; inspect JSON; reload.
steps.expected_results: Second "Task deleted successfully."; only fixture C remains, identical field-for-field to bBefore C; both b-alpha and b-beta are absent.

records.tcase_name: TC-B-041 - Canceled edit does not contaminate subsequent deletion

steps.expected_results: "Edit Task" opens for A with "Cancel" and "Save Changes".

steps.actions: Replace title with "Unsaved deletion title"; click "Cancel"; click "Delete Prepare sprint review".
steps.expected_results: "Delete Task" shows exactly Are you sure you want to delete "Prepare sprint review"? This cannot be undone. The abandoned title is not used.
"Delete Task" closes; "Task deleted successfully." appears. Only b-alpha is absent from taskflow_tasks; B and C are unchanged, including all timestamps. Reload still contains exactly B and C.
